# graphcodedemo — Non-Functional Requirements

> GENERATED from `docs/graph/graphcodedemo.graph.json` (SSOT). REQ mit kinds ∋ "non-functional". 6 NFR. Deterministisch generiert.

| NFR | Budget / constraint | Verified |
|---|---|---|
| `REQ-alarm-latency` | A safety-relevant fault appears on the control center dashboard no later than two seconds after it was detected. | ✓ |
| `REQ-passenger-information` | Passengers in the cabin receive an understandable situation announcement within 30 seconds of the stop, and an update at least every two minutes thereafter. | ✓ |
| `REQ-picture-freshness` | Every displayed state value is at most three seconds old; older values are marked as stale. | ✓ |
| `REQ-ride-comfort` | Longitudinal acceleration and deceleration stay below 1.2 meters per second squared in normal operation, so that standing passengers can hold on safely. | ✓ |
| `REQ-stopping-accuracy` | The cabin stops with a longitudinal deviation of at most 50 millimeters from the platform screen door, so that the gap does not exceed the permitted width. | ✓ |
| `REQ-waiting-time-promise` | The waiting time shown to the passenger is met in at least 95 percent of cases in normal operation; deviations of more than 60 seconds are actively reported. | ✓ |
